# proxmox_qemu_agent_file_write (Resource)

Writes a file through the guest agent at `POST /nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}/agent/file-write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_qemu_agent_file_write" "f" {
  node     = "pve-1"
  vmid     = 300
  file     = "/tmp/hello"
  content  = "hello"
  triggers = { gen = "1" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String, Sensitive)
- `file` (String)
- `node` (String)
- `triggers` (Map of String)
- `vmid` (Number)

### Optional

- `encode` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
